transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because for the past few months, things have kept happening that don’t feel accidental. My sister’s appointments get moved, bills come in wrong, people don’t call me back when they said they would. Everyone acts like it’s just mistakes, but I think they’re withholding information from me and trying to leave me out of decisions.
Along with everything that's been happening over these past few months, how has your mood been?
I’m not sure what you mean by my mood. I’ve been concerned and frustrated by what’s been going on, but I wouldn’t say there’s been some big change in how I feel otherwise.
Have you ever heard voices or other sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No, I haven’t heard voices or sounds that other people couldn’t hear.
Have you ever felt like thoughts that were not your own were being placed into your mind?
No. My thoughts feel like my own.
Before these past few months, have you generally tended to be distrustful or suspicious of other people's motives throughout your life?
I don’t know that I’ve generally been that way, no. I’ve usually tried to take people at face value.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast out loud so that other people could hear them?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like my thoughts being heard by other people.
Have you ever felt that your body, actions, or feelings were being directly controlled by an outside force?
No, I haven’t felt like someone else was controlling my body or making me do things.
